calc.description: calc_v1 (panel genesis mint 2026-10-13): parameter block copied VERBATIM from the served h100_broad_v1_calc_v13 registry doc (iqm_alpha 0.16666, 15-min slot grid from 2026-08-28, carry-forward 72h, pre-smoothing 1h, attendance eta 0.5, population-floor scaling) so this lane is the same engine generation as the six live lanes; METHODOLOGY.md is the binding contract. RECORD: raw-observatory snapshots from the 2026-08-27 genesis (first day of the 15-min record). TIER SCREEN: allow-list on-demand only. NO parity leg: no predecessor series. SKU SET: {RTX_PRO_6000}. IDENTITY SCREEN: reject_tokens [MIG, MAX Q, WORKSTATION, WS] on sku_identifier (verified 2026-10-13 against the engine's boundary matcher: drops exactly runpod's MIG 1g.24gb / 2g.48gb, Max-Q and Workstation Edition rows and vast's 'RTX PRO 6000 WS' hosts, nothing else). VARIANT RULES: coreweave/lium/runpod require SERVER, hyperstack requires SE, vast requires the standalone S token ('RTX PRO 6000 S' is vast's own chip name); verda, nebius, e2e, latitude, oracle, sesterce_console, massedcompute are declared seats (unqualified labels; each notes field quotes the surface). MARKETPLACE STATISTICS: vast_vwm_verified_us_ca_floor and lium_vwm_book_floor as on the H panels. VAST SEAT TIMING: the engine's population-accounting gate needs book_stats.verified_us_ca_machines, which the vast collector emits only for chips in raw_observatory.json options.population_gpu_names; that list gains this lane's vast chip name(s) with fcp #142 (the vast capture change). Until that deploy the seat is held out no_population_accounting on EVERY observation, including the whole replayed record 2026-08-27 -> deploy, which is NOT backfillable (the record was captured without the accounting); the seat prices from the deploy forward. RECORD FACTS (47-day persistence scan 2026-10-12, canonical slot): direct seats printed on 41-47 of 47 days (nebius 44, sesterce console 41), lium 46, vast dark until fcp #142. LIVE-PROBE FIGURES at mint (2026-10-13 capture, screened, NOT lane prints): direct seats 1.69 to 6.00 (latitude the ceiling -- a real bare-metal rate card, admitted, expect a permanent CI-fence outlier); the vast S book's cheapest ask was 1.17 but the lane cannot print vast yet (see VAST SEAT TIMING).

description: RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell SERVER panel (the SKU-expansion scoping record (fcp METHODOLOGY.md)). Underlying: the passive Server Edition 96GB part on-demand. The part ships as Server Edition, Workstation Edition, Max-Q Workstation and MIG slices, priced apart (runpod lists all four under one name; the lowest-eligible rule would print its $0.50 MIG slice unscreened), so this panel carries a panel-level reject list (MIG, MAX Q, WORKSTATION, WS) and per-seat label rules where the provider's own label names the form factor; unqualified datacenter rate cards seat as declared with the provider-surface evidence quoted. 12 members (10 direct + vast + lium statistic seats), weight floor 1.25%, claim floor 8. The vast seat prices only once fcp #142 adds 'RTX PRO 6000 S' to the capture's population_gpu_names (held out no_population_accounting before that deploy, replayed record included). gpuai deliberately NOT seated (ruling 2026-10-12). Selection over the raw-observatory record; captures nothing.
